_comment: Non-secret identifiers for the two controlled Google sources.
Both files are shared read-only via link, so there is no credential here
and none is needed in GitHub Actions -- the workflow curls the public
export endpoints. Nothing in this repo is a secret; if these IDs leak,
the worst outcome is that someone reads 18 rows of synthetic data.
If this were ever pointed at real company data, the export URLs would be
replaced by a service account with read-only scope and the JSON key
stored in the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON repository secret.
